description: Outbuilding at rear to be used as entertainment space and home gym.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location PlanBlock PlanSite Photos250200140GRS1Method Statement & Foundation InfoReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for purposes incidental to the residential use of 26 Claremont Road Barnet EN4 0HP and shall not be occupied independently as a self-contained unit.Reason: To ensure that the outbuilding does not adversely affect the amenity of adjoining residential premises, is not out of keeping with the pattern of surrounding development and is not used for unauthorised purposes, in accordance with Development Plan Policies.

The development shall not commence until a detailed design and methodology for foundation installation of the proposed outbuilding, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall outline the methodology for careful hand digging, the relocation of holes when roots are encountered, the use of impermeable membranes before pouring concrete, and the mixing of concrete away from tree root zones. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.Reason: In order to maintain the tree(s) amenity value and health.
